plugins.description: Guide the conversion of Polypoint P2 Delphi VCL forms (.dfm/.pas) and frames into Angular standalone components — analyzing DFM/PAS sources, mapping VCL components to Angular + @pdx/* equivalents, and emitting PDX-styled features with NgRx Signal Store and Signal Forms.
